title: A turn whose code closes the kit sees its close return, neither cut nor waiting for the turn it runs under, and the kit is closed
notes: Python: tests/test_kit_close_doors.py::test_a_close_from_a_tool_returns_and_seals_the_kit; the in-memory backend runs the turn in a copy of the owner's context, so the close knows the turns its caller runs under: core/framework.py close and _shut_down, turns/owner.py _close, which abandons the owner's open turns, and turns/executor.py _close, which spares the call's own task. A close waiting for the turn its call awaits would never return, and a close cutting its caller would record no result. That the turn is cut is not observed: once the close returned, the kit is sealed and nothing the turn could still do shows.
